_readme: Business details used on every page. Edit here, then run `node build.mjs`. Values marked PLACEHOLDER must be replaced before launch.
name: Pittsburgh Chimney Sweeps
announcement: Now booking fall sweeps. Book before burning season.

services.name: Chimney Sweeping
services.short: Creosote and soot removal with a Level 1 inspection included.

services.name: Chimney Inspections
services.short: Level 1, 2 and 3 inspections with HD camera and photo report.

services.name: Masonry & Tuckpointing
services.short: Repointing, spalling brick repair and partial or full rebuilds.

services.name: Caps & Crowns
services.short: Stainless and copper caps, crown repair and rebuilds.

services.name: Chimney Liners
services.short: Stainless steel relining for wood, gas and oil appliances.

services.name: Leaks & Waterproofing
services.short: Flashing repair, leak diagnosis and breathable water repellent.

services.name: Fireplace & Stove Service
services.short: Dampers, gas fireplaces, inserts, wood and pellet stoves.

services.name: Dryer Vent Cleaning
services.short: Full-length vent cleaning, airflow testing and bird guards.

services.name: Animal & Nest Removal
services.short: Humane removal of birds and animals, then a cap to keep them out.

reviews.name: Sample review
reviews.text: They showed up inside the window, laid drop cloths through the whole living room, and texted me photos of the flue before they'd even packed up. No soot anywhere.

reviews.name: Sample review
reviews.text: Our home inspector flagged the chimney two weeks before closing. They got us a Level 2 camera inspection in two days and the report was clear enough for both realtors.

reviews.name: Sample review
reviews.text: Another company wanted to rebuild the whole chimney. These guys tuckpointed the bad section, replaced the crown, and saved us thousands. Honest people.

reviews.name: Sample review
reviews.text: Our dryer was taking two cycles per load. They cleaned the whole vent run to the roof, showed us the lint they pulled out, and now it dries in one.

reviews.name: Sample review
reviews.text: Clear explanation of why our clay tiles failed, a written price, and the liner went in the same week. The crew was careful with our landscaping too.

reviews.name: Sample review
reviews.text: We had a water stain by the chimney for two winters. They found failed flashing, fixed it, and the ceiling has stayed dry through every storm since.
